summary: The proposed patch introduces a new approach to handle duplicate options in formfields with limit_choices_to, which may not be optimal and could introduce performance issues.

issues.description: The use of Exists() with OuterRef can lead to inefficient queries, especially for large datasets, and may not be the most straightforward solution to avoid duplicates.
The change could introduce a performance regression due to the complexity of the query generated by using Exists() with OuterRef.
The commit message and inline comments should provide more context about why the current approach is problematic and how the new approach resolves it.
